sentence: This project develops algorithms that schedule tasks so AI models take less time and energy to train and to run.
This project studies how neuropeptides control the change from a larva into a juvenile form in a sea anemone.
This project builds a curriculum on how AI agents can make decisions on their own in manufacturing research.
This project tries to find out how strong light can create magnetism in quantum materials such as graphene.
This project studies why people and urban carnivores such as coyotes and raccoons end up in conflict or coexistence in cities.
This project makes organic dyes and tests how changes to their structure affect how they take in and give off near-infrared light.
This project tests how well vetiver grass takes up heavy metals and other contaminants from soil and wastewater.
This project tries to use magnetic nanojunctions to control single nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamonds and how two of them interact.
This project builds tools that use large language models to help detect and investigate targeted cyberattacks on computer systems.
This project builds a very small probe that applies a localized electric field to a receiving system to measure how it responds.
This project combines signals from different types of cameras to capture the 3D shape, motion, materials and lighting of real-world scenes.
This project gets a high-performance computing cluster that many researchers use for simulations and analysis in fields from astrophysics to ecology.
This project makes cyclic polymers in larger amounts with a catalyst and tests how they perform under electrical and physical forces.
This project develops statistical tools that draw reliable conclusions from complex data and from machine learning models.
This project studies a bacterial immune system that finds and cuts target DNA, and tries to reprogram it as a tool for genome editing.
This project builds a course platform, an AI tutor and visual tools that teach quantum computing.
